goal: Build Circuit Sprint 3D, an original browser-based 3D overhead racer. Write one small bounded module now. Return source code immediately without explanation or a markdown fence.

tasks.objective: Write complete src/track.js as a plain JavaScript ES module. Create a continuous oval-like 3D road with curb and grass, then expose nearest road point lookup. Return code immediately.
interfaces: import * as THREE from 'three'; export function createTrack(scene).

Return { samples, halfWidth, start, nearest, onRoad }. samples is an ordered closed loop of at least 180 {x,z} points; halfWidth is road half-width. start is {x,z,yaw}; car forward is (sin(yaw),cos(yaw)).
nearest(x,z) returns {x,z,tangentX,tangentZ,distance,progress,index}; progress is 0..1. onRoad(x,z) tests distance <= halfWidth.
acceptance_checks: Road, curb, ground and start line use original procedural Three.js geometry; no external assets.
nearest returns usable tangent and progress everywhere on the loop.
Valid JavaScript for Three.js 0.186.0; output raw code only.
tasks.context: World axes: XZ ground and Y up. One module only. Keep code short and direct. The game camera will be tilted overhead and show the full track.
